classes.name: CDMPartner
classes.definition: A generalization of the parties that take part in the Airport CDM process and originate or receive its information.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The identifying name of the stakeholder that originates or receives information in the Airport CDM process.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline or its representative that submits the ATC Flight Plan, provides TOBT and other estimates, and manages the turn-round.

operations.name: submitFlightPlan
operations.description: The ATC Flight Plan is submitted by the Aircraft Operator, normally 3 hours before EOBT although it may be later, or as a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (milestone 1).

operations.name: provideFinalTOBT
operations.description: The Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides their most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation, t minutes before EOBT where t is a locally agreed parameter (milestone 9).

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party that performs ground handling operations and, together with the Aircraft Operator, provides turn-round related times such as ACGT, ARDT and TOBT.

operations.name: recordACGT
operations.description: The Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides the Actual Commence of Ground Handling time (ACGT), available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 8).

operations.name: recordARDT
operations.description: The Ground Handler provides the Actual Ready Time (ARDT) when all doors are closed, boarding bridge removed and push back vehicle connected, ready to taxi immediately upon reception of TWR instructions (milestone 12).

operations.name: recordASBT
operations.description: ASBT is provided automatically from the airport system or by manual input by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler when the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding (milestone 11).

classes.name: AirTrafficControlUnit
classes.definition: The ATC unit (tower, approach, or area control centre) that detects flight progress, issues TSAT/ASAT and manages the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: issueTSAT
operations.description: ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time (TSAT) t-minutes before EOBT, where t is a parameter agreed locally (milestone 10).

operations.name: calculateEXOT
operations.description: Following receipt of the TOBT, the ATC system calculates and provides the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on the predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position (milestone 9).

operations.name: recordASRT
operations.description: ATC records the Actual Start up Request Time (ASRT), based on pilot request, available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 13).

operations.name: confirmTSATToPilot
operations.description: ATC confirms TSAT to the pilot in order to maintain the aircraft in the pre-departure sequence (milestone 13).

operations.name: recordASAT
operations.description: ATC provides the Actual start up Approval Time (ASAT) when the aircraft receives its start up approval, available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestone 14).

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The Network Manager function that issues CTOT, monitors flight progress and receives DPI messages to coordinate the flight with the wider ATM network.

operations.name: issueCTOT
operations.description: The CTOT is issued by the Network Operations at EOBT-2h if the flight is regulated, and is sent to relevant ATS units as well as the departure aerodrome (milestone 2).

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: If the flight is within 3hrs flying time of the destination airport, Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS (milestone 3).

operations.name: sendFlightUpdateMessage
operations.description: Network Operations sends a Flight Update Message (FUM) that provides updates of the flight's progress, used to update ELDT (milestones 1, 3).

classes.name: FlightCrew
classes.definition: The pilot and cockpit crew who request start-up and push-back and coordinate with the Ground Handler around TSAT.

classes.name: StandGateManagement
classes.definition: The stakeholder responsible for stand and gate allocation who shares EOBT information with ATC and Network Operations.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single arriving or departing operation of an aircraft, tracked through the sixteen milestones and carrying an operational status.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The current operational status of the flight, updated as each milestone occurs (e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, LANDED, OFF_BLOCK).

attributes.name: isRegulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight has received a CTOT from Network Operations and its fields are marked REGULATED (milestone 2).

attributes.name: offBlockTime
attributes.description: The successive scheduled, estimated, target and actual off-block time values (SOBT, EOBT, TOBT, AOBT) recorded for the flight.

attributes.name: inBlockTime
attributes.description: The successive estimated and actual in-block time values (EIBT, AIBT) recorded for the flight.

attributes.name: landingTime
attributes.description: The successive estimated and actual landing time values (ELDT, ALDT) recorded for the flight.

attributes.name: takeOffTime
attributes.description: The successive estimated, target, calculated and actual take-off time values (ETOT, TTOT, CTOT, ATOT) recorded for the flight.

attributes.name: startUpApprovalTime
attributes.description: The target and actual start-up approval time values (TSAT, ASAT) recorded for the flight.

attributes.name: boardingTime
attributes.description: The actual start boarding time (ASBT) recorded for the flight, accurate to +/-1 minute (milestone 11).

attributes.name: readyTime
attributes.description: The actual ready time (ARDT) recorded for the flight, accurate to +/-1 minute (milestone 12).

attributes.name: startUpRequestTime
attributes.description: The actual start-up request time (ASRT) recorded for the flight, accurate to +/-1 minute (milestone 13).

attributes.name: groundHandlingStartTime
attributes.description: The actual commencement of ground handling time (ACGT) recorded for the flight, accurate to +/-1 minute (milestone 8).

attributes.name: taxiOutTime
attributes.description: The Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) calculated by ATC based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use and holding-position waiting period (milestone 9).

attributes.name: taxiInTime
attributes.description: The estimated taxi-in time (EXIT) used together with ELDT to compute EIBT (milestones 4, 6).

attributes.name: minimumTurnRoundTime
attributes.description: The Minimum Turn-round Time (MTTT) used with EIBT and EXOT as a basis for calculating TTOT (milestones 2, 3).

attributes.name: estimatedTurnRoundTime
attributes.description: The Estimated Turn-round Time (ETTT) used to update TOBT after ground handling starts (milestone 8).

attributes.name: parkingPosition
attributes.description: The stand or gate currently assigned to the flight, changes to which are avoided after ELDT-30 minutes (milestone 4).

operations.name: updateOperationalStatus
operations.description: The flight's operational status changes to the value defined by each milestone as it occurs, e.g. INITIATED (milestone 1), AIRBORNE (milestone 3), FIR (milestone 4), FINAL (milestone 5), LANDED (milestone 6), IN-BLOCK (milestones 7, 8, 9), SEQUENCED (milestone 10), BOARDING (milestone 11), READY (milestone 12), OFF-BLOCK (milestone 15), DEPARTED/TAKE OFF (milestone 16).

operations.name: calculateEIBT
operations.description: An estimated in-block time (EIBT) is computed using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time (milestone 4); the EIBT can be updated according to the ALDT+EXIT (milestone 6).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round linking an arriving flight and its related departing flight for the purpose of estimating and analysing turn-round times.

attributes.name: period
attributes.description: The defined or estimated turn-round period (MTTT/ETTT) on which the departing flight's TOBT and TTOT updates are based (milestones 6, 7, 8).

operations.name: calculateTOBTFromTurnRoundPeriod
operations.description: TOBT for the departing flight is updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the defined or estimated turn-round period, following ALDT (milestone 6), AIBT (milestone 7) or ACGT (milestone 8).

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft operating a flight, identified by type and registration, which the ATC Flight Plan may be used to update.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration that must be provided consistently before the first E-DPI message is sent (milestone 1).

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: The type of aircraft, which the ATC Flight Plan may be used to update (milestone 1).

classes.name: FlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO/ATC Flight Plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by IFPS, including repetitive flight plans (RFPL), against which flight estimates are checked for consistency.

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether the submitted flight plan is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (milestone 1).

attributes.name: destination
attributes.description: The first destination aerodrome data that must be consistent and correct before the first E-DPI message is sent (milestone 1).

attributes.name: estimatedElapsedTime
attributes.description: The Estimated Elapsed Time stated on the flight plan, used together with ATOT to calculate ELDT (milestone 3).

operations.name: checkConsistencyWithAirportSlot
operations.description: The ATC Flight Plan corresponds to the airport slot programme (milestone 1).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry that the ATC Flight Plan must correspond to for consistency checking at coordinated airports.

attributes.name: assignedTime
attributes.description: The time assigned by the airport slot programme, with which the ATC Flight Plan must be consistent; for long-distance flights the ELDT may differ from this slot time (milestone 1).

classes.name: ParkingPosition
classes.definition: The stand or gate assigned to a flight, changes to which are discouraged after ELDT-30 minutes.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: The stand or gate identifier assigned to the flight.

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: A named time value describing a flight's progress toward a milestone event, distinguished by a prefix (Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual, Calculated) and an event (e.g. Off-Block, In-Block, Landing, Take-Off, Start-Up Approval, Boarding, Ready, Start-Up Request, Ground Handling Start); every successive value is appended with its originator and time of update rather than overwritten.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Whether this value is a Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual or Calculated time for its event.

attributes.name: event
attributes.description: The milestone event this time quantity describes, e.g. Off-Block, In-Block, Landing or Take-Off.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time of the estimated, target, calculated or actual occurrence.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy of this value, typically +/-1 minute for actual times recorded directly at occurrence (e.g. ALDT, AIBT, AOBT, ATOT, ASBT, ARDT, ASRT, ASAT).

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The stakeholder or system that provided or last updated this value.

attributes.name: recordedAt
attributes.description: The time this value was appended to the flight's record, so that a turn-round can be analysed afterwards without overwriting prior values.

classes.name: DurationEstimate
classes.definition: A calculated time interval such as the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT), Estimated Taxi-In Time (EXIT), Minimum Turn-round Time (MTTT) or Estimated Turn-round Time (ETTT), used as input to compute event-based time quantities.

attributes.name: durationType
attributes.description: The kind of calculated interval this estimate represents (Taxi-Out Time, Taxi-In Time, Minimum Turn-round Time or Estimated Turn-round Time).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The length of the estimated interval.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: A generalization of the sixteen defined events in the CDM turn-round process, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect and procedure applied over the flight's entity classes.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: The milestone number (1 to 16) identifying this event in the CDM turn-round process.

attributes.name: resultingStatus
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to when this milestone occurs.

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The locally agreed tolerance for TTOT change (e.g. 5 minutes at take-off from outstation) beyond which Network Operations must be re-informed.

classes.name: MilestoneFlightPlanActivation
classes.definition: Milestone 1: submission and activation of the ATC Flight Plan, initiating the Airport CDM Platform for the flight and checking consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: activationOffset
attributes.description: The normal timing of this milestone, 3 hours before EOBT, though it may occur later.

attributes.name: readinessOffset
attributes.description: The maximum time after the planned EOBT, 15 minutes, by which the flight must be ready.

operations.name: checkFlightPlanConsistency
operations.description: A check shall be performed to verify the consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent (milestone 1).

operations.name: confirmFlightToNetworkOperations
operations.description: The process confirms the flight to the Network Operations and allows further local processing of the flight, feeding Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data as early as possible (milestone 1).

operations.name: sendEDPI
operations.description: The E-DPI message should not be sent if no or inconsistent information is provided by the AO before this first E-DPI message (milestone 1).

classes.name: MilestoneEOBTMinus2Hours
classes.definition: Milestone 2: at EOBT-2 hours, regulated flights receive a CTOT and estimates are checked against the ATC Flight Plan before informing Network Operations via the first T-DPI.

attributes.name: offsetBeforeEOBT
attributes.description: The fixed timing of this milestone, 2 hours before EOBT, at which a CTOT is issued for regulated flights.

operations.name: checkEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: A check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimated off block time at EOBT-2 hrs, checking whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 2).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsViaTDPI
operations.description: At EOBT-2 hrs Network Operations is informed through the first T-DPI message of the updated take off time estimate (milestone 2).

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, if later than EOBT+EXOT. In the case of manual input of TOBT, this estimate overrides the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT (milestone 2).

classes.name: MilestoneTakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation is used to check estimated landing time consistency with the outbound ATC Flight Plan and, if the TTOT tolerance is exceeded, inform Network Operations via a T-DPI-t.

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: A check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan at take off from outstation, checking whether the AO/GH estimated landing time is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan (milestone 3).

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: A TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before Network Operations is informed of the updated TTOT using a T-DPI-t Message (milestone 3).

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT. In case EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT. Where TOBT is available this prediction overrules the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT (milestone 3).

operations.name: calculateELDTFromATOT
operations.description: Using the ATOT an ELDT can be calculated by using the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL, if the departure airport is more than 3hrs flying time from the destination airport (milestone 3).

classes.name: MilestoneLocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: Milestone 4: detection of the flight entering the FIR or local airspace, commencing the TOBT process and checking TOBT feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: The process commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT (milestone 4).

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance (milestone 4).

classes.name: MilestoneFinalApproach
classes.definition: Milestone 5: detection of the flight entering Final Approach, commencing the TOBT process and checking TOBT feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: The process commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT (milestone 5).

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance (milestone 5).

classes.name: MilestoneLanded
classes.definition: Milestone 6: the actual landing time (ALDT) triggers updates to TOBT and TTOT based on the defined turn-round period and checks TOBT feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: A check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 6).

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: A TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT (milestone 6).

classes.name: MilestoneInBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 7: the actual in-block time (AIBT) triggers updates to TOBT and TTOT based on the estimated turn-round period and checks TOBT feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: A check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 7).

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: A TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT (milestone 7).

classes.name: MilestoneGroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: Milestone 8: the actual commencement of ground handling (ACGT) triggers a TOBT update based on the estimated turn-round period and checks TOBT feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: A check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 8).

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: A TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT (milestone 8).

classes.name: MilestoneFinalTOBTConfirmation
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides their most accurate TOBT before EOBT, which is checked against the ATC Flight Plan prior to TSAT issue.

attributes.name: confirmationOffset
attributes.description: The locally agreed parameter t, the number of minutes before EOBT at which the AO/GH provides their most accurate final TOBT.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: A check should be performed at a predefined time (local parameter) to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue and verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimates given the updated TOBT, checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 9).

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTExceedsTolerance
operations.description: A TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT (milestone 9).

classes.name: MilestoneTSATIssued
classes.definition: Milestone 10: ATC issues the TSAT, informs partners and Network Operations, and checks the number of TOBT updates after TSAT against a local tolerance.

attributes.name: issueOffset
attributes.description: The locally agreed parameter t, the number of minutes before EOBT/TOBT at which ATC issues the TSAT.

attributes.name: tobtUpdateThreshold
attributes.description: The locally defined threshold on the number of TOBT updates permitted after TSAT has been issued before local procedure is applied.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTSAT
operations.description: All relevant partners are informed of the TSAT that has been allocated to the flight; Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non regulated flights (milestone 10).

operations.name: checkTOBTUpdatesAfterTSAT
operations.description: A check shall be performed to see the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued against a tolerance defined locally; in case the number of TOBT updates exceeds this threshold, the TOBT input should be processed according to local procedure (milestone 10).

classes.name: MilestoneBoardingStarts
classes.definition: Milestone 11: boarding of passengers begins; partners are informed of ASBT and boarding status is checked against TOBT.

attributes.name: boardingCheckOffset
attributes.description: The local variable time before TOBT (e.g. based on aircraft type) at which boarding status is checked.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASBT
operations.description: All relevant Airport CDM Partners are informed of the Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs (milestone 11).

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a certain time before TOBT (local variable e.g. corresponding to aircraft type) a check shall be performed to check the boarding status, checking whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT, and to inform the AO/GH in case TOBT needs to be updated (milestone 11).

classes.name: MilestoneAircraftReady
classes.definition: Milestone 12: the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back (ARDT); partners are informed and, past TOBT plus tolerance without a ready status, the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler is alerted.

attributes.name: readyTolerance
attributes.description: The tolerance added to TOBT after which the AO/GH is informed that no ARDT or Ready Status has been received.

operations.name: informPartnersOfARDT
operations.description: All relevant Airport CDM Partners are informed of Actual Ready Time (ARDT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft is ready for start up/push-back (milestone 12).

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance the AO/GH are informed that TOBT has passed and there has not been a ready status message (ARDT or RDY) yet (milestone 12).

classes.name: MilestoneStartUpRequested
classes.definition: Milestone 13: ATC records the actual start-up request time (ASRT) and alerts partners if no request is made within the TSAT tolerance window.

attributes.name: requestTolerance
attributes.description: The locally agreed TSAT tolerance window within which a start-up request must be made before partners are alerted.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASRT
operations.description: All relevant Airport CDM Partners are informed of Actual Start up Request Time (ASRT) in the Airport CDM Platform when it occurs (milestone 13).

operations.name: alertIfNoStartUpRequested
operations.description: If the start up request is not made by TSAT + tolerance, all relevant Airport CDM Partners are alerted and the AO/GH is informed that no start up has been requested and should update TOBT (milestone 13).

classes.name: MilestoneStartUpApproved
classes.definition: Milestone 14: ATC records the actual start-up approval time (ASAT), checks it against TSAT, and alerts and re-sequences the flight if approval is not granted within tolerance.

attributes.name: approvalTolerance
attributes.description: The tolerance added to TSAT after which, if start-up approval has not been granted, all partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASAT
operations.description: All relevant Airport CDM Partners are informed of Actual start up approval Time (ASAT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has received start up approval/push-back clearance when it occurs (milestone 14).

operations.name: checkASATAgainstTSAT
operations.description: A check shall be performed to see if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT (milestone 14).

operations.name: alertAndResequenceIfNoApproval
operations.description: In case the start up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all relevant partners are informed and the flight will be re-sequenced (milestone 14).

classes.name: MilestoneOffBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 15: the actual off-block time (AOBT) is recorded, TTOT is updated considering EXOT, and an A-DPI is sent to Network Operations, with further A-DPIs if TTOT changes beyond tolerance.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAOBT
operations.description: All relevant Airport CDM Partners are informed of Actual Off-Block Time (AOBT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has commenced push-back/taxi from parking position, when it occurs (milestone 15).

operations.name: sendADPI
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or in the case of remote holding at a defined time prior to TTOT (milestone 15).

operations.name: checkTTOTAfterAOBT
operations.description: After a first A-DPI is sent this check shall be performed to check TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT (milestone 15).

classes.name: MilestoneTakeOff
classes.definition: Milestone 16: the actual take-off time (ATOT) is recorded, FSA and MVT messages are sent, and the flight is removed from the departure sequence.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTakeOff
operations.description: All relevant Airport CDM Partners are informed about the actual take off (milestone 16).

operations.name: generateAirborneMessage
operations.description: An airborne message is generated and FSA and MVT messages are sent (milestone 16).

operations.name: removeFromDepartureSequence
operations.description: The flight is removed from the departure sequence following take off (milestone 16).

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform that is initiated for each flight, holds all available flight information, and performs the ACISP checks, updates and notifications defined for each milestone.

operations.name: initiateForFlight
operations.description: The Airport CDM Platform is initiated for this flight, and all available information is processed (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateEstimatesOnActivation
operations.description: For an arrival, ELDT and EIBT are updated; for a departure, EOBT and ETOT are updated (milestone 1).

operations.name: markRegulated
operations.description: ETOT/TTOT/CTOT are updated and appropriate fields are marked as REGULATED (milestone 2).

operations.name: updateEstimatesAfterOutstationTakeOff
operations.description: ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT are updated following take off from outstation (milestone 3).

operations.name: updateEstimatesAfterRadarUpdate
operations.description: ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT are updated following local radar detection of the flight (milestone 4).

operations.name: updateEstimatesAfterFinalApproach
operations.description: ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT are updated following detection of final approach (milestone 5).

operations.name: updateEstimatesAfterLanding
operations.description: ELDT changes to ALDT, and EIBT, TOBT and TTOT are updated (milestone 6).

operations.name: updateEstimatesAfterInBlock
operations.description: EIBT changes to AIBT, and TOBT and TTOT are updated (milestone 7).

operations.name: updateEstimatesAfterGroundHandlingStart
operations.description: ETTT/TOBT and TTOT are updated (milestone 8).

operations.name: updateTTOTAfterTSAT
operations.description: TTOT is updated following TSAT issue (milestone 10).

operations.name: recordAOBT
operations.description: AOBT is recorded in the Airport CDM Platform (milestone 15).

operations.name: recordATOT
operations.description: ATOT is recorded in the Airport CDM Platform (milestone 16).

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The Integrated Initial Flight Plan Processing System that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: The ATC Flight Plan is submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by the IFPS; all involved ATC units receive the flight plan, including departure and destination aerodromes (milestone 1).

classes.name: ATCSystem
classes.definition: The ATC/radar system (including A-SMGCS and Tower FDPS) that detects flight position and provides milestone times such as ELDT, ALDT, AIBT, AOBT and ATOT.

operations.name: detectMilestoneEvent
operations.description: The ATC system (including A-SMGCS and Tower FDPS) or radar detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when it crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary, range/position, or level, providing milestone times with an accuracy equal to that of the ATC system (milestones 4, 5, 6, 9, 15, 16).

classes.name: ACARS
classes.definition: The aircraft reporting system that provides actual times such as ALDT, AIBT, AOBT and ATOT from equipped aircraft.

operations.name: provideActualTime
operations.description: ACARS equipped aircraft provide actual times such as ALDT (ACARS=ON), AIBT (ACARS=IN), AOBT (ACARS=OUT) and ATOT (ACARS=OFF), available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute (milestones 6, 7, 15, 16).

classes.name: ETFMS
classes.definition: The system used by Network Operations to monitor flight progress and issue Flight Update Messages when a flight is close to its destination.

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI) exchanged between the Airport CDM Platform and Network Operations to convey flight and take-off time estimates.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of Departure Planning Information message being sent (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s or A-DPI).

attributes.name: scheduledOffBlockTime
attributes.description: The SOBT conveyed in the E-DPI message, required to be consistent before the first E-DPI is sent (milestone 1).

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration conveyed in the E-DPI message, required to be consistent before the first E-DPI is sent (milestone 1).

attributes.name: destination
attributes.description: The first destination data conveyed in the E-DPI message, required to be consistent before the first E-DPI is sent (milestone 1).

attributes.name: takeOffTimeEstimate
attributes.description: The updated take-off time estimate (ETOT/TTOT) conveyed by a T-DPI, T-DPI-t or T-DPI-s message.

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: The FUM sent by Network Operations providing updates of an inbound flight's progress and estimated landing time.

attributes.name: estimatedLandingTime
attributes.description: The updated ELDT provided by the FUM based on the flight's actual progress as monitored by ETFMS (milestones 1, 3).

classes.name: CDMPartnerNotification
classes.definition: A notification sent to all relevant Airport CDM Partners informing them of an actual time (e.g. ASBT, ARDT, ASRT, ASAT, AOBT, ATOT), a ready status, or a departure message (FSA, MVT, airborne).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of event or status this notification conveys (e.g. ASBT, ARDT, ASRT, ASAT, AOBT, ATOT, RDY, FSA, MVT).

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The time at which the notified event occurred.

packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

unmodelled: The document distinguishes coordinated and non-coordinated airports, affecting whether the outbound flight is already known when the flight plan is activated (milestone 1).
Reference to 'attachment 2' and 'section 3.7.3' for further DPI process implementation details is made without describing their content (milestone 1).

Milestone 8 (Ground Handling Started) applies specifically to flights that are the first operation of the day or have been long-term parked; for a normal turn-round, ground handling is considered to commence at AIBT instead (milestone 8).
CTOT-regulated flights usually have priority over unregulated flights, without a stated rule for how this priority is applied (milestone 2).
A start-up request may be made by the flight crew via voice or Data Link Clearance (DCL), or omitted in favour of a locally defined time around TSAT (milestone 14).

Boarding start (physical gate opening) is explicitly distinguished from the earlier pre-call of passengers via FIDS or public address systems, without further data captured for the pre-call (milestone 11).
